args.title: Cold-chain logistics 2026 — combined summary (Saltmarsh blog + companion)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/cold-chain and its companion piece (https://insights.saltmarsh.example/cold-chain/companion):

• Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
• Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
• Companion analysis: pilot programs cut claims by a quarter (~25%).
